text:
clara: Small onboarding hit today. Node sampleapp using the batching helper called /v1/embeddings (rerank) and sometimes got 512-d vectors instead of 768, and once an empty embeddings array.

sam: any headers or retry info?

clara: headers when wrong: x-redwood-model-variant: rerank-1-compact, x-retry-count: 1. Call used default batching helper config (no explicit fallback_model).

ivor: that indicates the helper retried on a 429 and switched to a compact fallback. Node batching helper had a default fallback set; python didn't because it uses a different config key. SDK parity gap.

liz: the empty-array case is worse: node helper normalized an empty body to [] and kept going. Python raises on empty body.

clara: impact was our retriever returned zero matches silently. Not great.

sam: quick mitigation for customers: set retry: { fallback_model: null } to disable implicit fallback, or retry: { fallback_model: 'rerank-1' } to force same model on retries. Also add a shape assertion before downstream use: if (!resp.embeddings || resp.embeddings.length === 0) throw; if (resp.embeddings[0].length !== expectedDim) throw.

ivor: I'll open DEVEX-4522 to: remove implicit fallback default in node helper, surface response.model_variant from x-redwood-model-variant across SDKs, and make node helper error on empty bodies.

ops-bot: Created DEVEX-4522 and queued PR #6177 (deploy to staging).

liz: short-term sampleapp polyfill we added to all SDKs:
```js
const raw = await client.embeddings.create(cfg)
const embeddings = raw.embeddings || raw.vectors || []
const dim = raw.embedding_dim || raw.dim || (embeddings[0] && embeddings[0].length)
if (!embeddings.length) throw new Error('empty embeddings from API')
if (dim !== expectedDim) throw new Error(`unexpected embedding dim: ${dim}`)
```
clara: confirmed explicit fallback_model: null fixed our repro locally. Will push a tiny onboarding doc PR to add the assert + note about model_variant headers.

sam: after DEVEX-4522 lands we should run a parity smoke across node/python/rust samples to catch key-name differences (embeddings vs vectors) and dim field names (embedding_dim vs dim).

ivor: also recommended: log response.model_variant in app telemetry so users can see when compact variants return.

clara: thanks all, closing for now once PRs merge :thumbsup:
